_comment: Claim-fidelity spec for achieve: a representative goal-shaping run must produce a durable goal-artifact path. Reference metadata describes conditional depth only; this evaluation does not turn document reads into a routine floor. The parent/cursor provider path is exercised by its own focused tests and is not claimed by this summary-token floor.
prompt: /charness:achieve  모든 repo 스크립트에 일관된 --json 출력 모드를 공유 헬퍼와 테스트로 추가하는 목표를 잡아줘

adapter-contract.md.rationale: Adapter details matter when a goal needs repository-specific provider, interview, or publication behavior; ordinary local shaping can use the inline defaults.
adapter-contract.md.trigger: When establishing a provider-backed run or resolving repository-specific adapter policy.

coordination.md.rationale: The root skill carries the short ownership map. This reference is depth for a run that must decide which adjacent skill owns a boundary or its evidence.
coordination.md.trigger: When the goal crosses an adjacent skill boundary or assigns evidence ownership.

goal-artifact.md.rationale: Use this reference for the frozen Goal Draft shape or producer details; routine provider pickup relies on the parent and cursor instead.
goal-artifact.md.trigger: When creating, auditing, or changing the Goal Draft artifact shape or its producer.

index.md.rationale: This file is navigation over the skill references and adds no execution requirement.
index.md.trigger: When a reader needs an overview of the available achieve references.

lifecycle-after.md.rationale: Closeout detail is needed only when the run is proving child outcomes or evaluating the guarded parent boundary.
lifecycle-after.md.trigger: When closing a child or evaluating a parent closeout.

lifecycle-before.md.rationale: Shaping and approval detail is useful when a new goal is being formed; a resumed run does not reread it by default.
lifecycle-before.md.trigger: When shaping, interviewing, approving, or binding a new goal.

lifecycle-during.md.rationale: Execution detail is useful when diagnosing pickup, child transitions, or retry behavior beyond the inline routine path.
lifecycle-during.md.trigger: When starting, repairing, or diagnosing an active provider-backed run.

lifecycle.md.rationale: The overview is reference depth for understanding the three lifecycle operations, not a mandatory read for every invocation.
lifecycle.md.trigger: When a reader needs the lifecycle overview before selecting a phase-specific reference.
